verdicts.title: On the connectedness of Deligne-Lusztig varieties
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We give a criterion which determines when a union of one-dimensional Deligne-Lusztig varieties has a connected closure. We also obtain a new, short proof of the connectedness criterion for Deligne-Lusztig varieties due to Lusztig.
